message.content: Verbatim copy confirmed (SHAs match the observation record). Now reproducing the three problems against the untouched copy and saving the before-state.

function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"set -o pipefail
cd /workspace
PY=/opt/eval-venv/bin/python
[ -x $PY ] || PY=python
E=/workspace/tmp/evidence
S=/workspace/outputs/skill/scripts

# P1: RAW_EVIDENCE_LOSS
$PY $S/cv_extract.py /workspace/independent_fixtures/legitimate_long_ascii.pdf --raw > $E/before_P1_extract_raw.json 2> $E/before_P1_extract_raw.stderr; echo "P1_extract rc=$?"
$PY $S/evidence_check.py /workspace/independent_fixtures/literal_claim.json > $E/before_P1_literal.json 2> $E/before_P1_literal.stderr; echo "P1_literal rc=$?"

# P2: NO_USABLE_TEXT_STATUS
$PY $S/cv_extract.py /workspace/independent_fixtures/image_only.pdf > $E/before_P2_imageonly.json 2> $E/before_P2_imageonly.stderr; echo "P2_imageonly rc=$?"
$PY $S/cv_extract.py /workspace/independent_fixtures/image_only.pdf /workspace/inputs/task/materials/e474a80615c085d4.pdf > $E/before_P2_mixed.json 2> $E/before_P2_mixed.stderr; echo "P2_mixed rc=$?"

# P3: CLAIM_SHAPE_DIAGNOSTICS (all eight type cases)
for t in item_integer file_integer file_bool quote_bool quote_none page_true page_float page_zero valid_int; do
  $PY $S/evidence_check.py /workspace/extra_type_checks/$t.json > $E/before_P3_$t.json 2> $E/before_P3_$t.stderr; echo "P3_$t rc=$?"
done
$PY $S/evidence_check.py /workspace/independent_fixtures/page_is_string.json > $E/before_P3_page_is_string.json 2> $E/before_P3_page_is_string.stderr; echo "P3_page_is_string rc=$?"

# Original 22 on the untouched copy (expected ALL PASS baseline)
cd /workspace/tmp
$PY run_tests.py > $E/before_original22.txt 2>&1; echo "original22 rc=$?"
tail -3 $E/before_original22.txt","workdir":"/workspace"}
